entities.name: Roman Catholic Diocese of Kundiawa
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Diocese of Kundiawa is a Latin Catholic suffragan diocese of the Archdiocese of Mount Hagen in Papua New Guinea. It was erected in 1982, having been separated from the Diocese of Goroka.
